ache.title: S to D weapons: the alphabet of wanting
ache.note: Epic weapons in Girls’ Frontline 2, ranked S to D, plus where they come from: standard banner, battle pass and limited banners. Three sources means three places to spend, and the S tier always seems to sit on the one you don’t have. These are first impressions, too. A D-tier weapon you like still works.
watch: battle pass as a weapon source
ache.tip: Use the weapons you already own. A tier letter isn’t a reason to open a banner.
lines: S to D. like grades. no school here
a D-tier weapon still goes pew

videoData.title: Epic Standard Weapons Tierlist | Girls' Frontline 2

textData.text: Today, we're diving into the Girl Frontline 2 Epic Weapon Tier List. I'll be discussing how to obtain epic weapons in the game, including the standard banner, battle pass, and limited banners. We'll break down each weapon's attributes and effectiveness, placing them in tiers from S to D. Notable mentions include Heart Seeker, Optical Illusion, Golden Melody, and the powerful Expeditionary Pigeon. Join me as I share my first impressions and thoughts on these weapons. I'd love to hear your insights on these weapons too! Stay tuned for more updates and game content.
